units.locator: Article 23.40. Authorities of the State Inspectorate for Small Vessels
units.text: Article 23.40. Authorities of the State Inspectorate for Small Vessels
units.label: Art. 23.40

units.locator: Article 23.40. Authorities of the State Inspectorate for Small Vessels
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.40. Authorities of the State Inspectorate for Small Vessels
units.label: Art. 23.40

units.locator: Article 23.40. Authorities of the State Inspectorate for Small Vessels
units.text: 1. Authorities of the State Inspectorate for Small Vessels shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.22 and 8.23 (with respect to authorising operation of and operating small vessels with pollutant content in emissions or noise levels exceeding the prescribed standards), part 2 of Article 11.7, Articles 11.8, 11.8.1 and 11.9 - 11.12, part 2 of Article 11.13, and part 2 of Article 19.22 (with respect to state registration of small vessels used for non-commercial purposes) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.40

units.locator: Article 23.40. Authorities of the State Inspectorate for Small Vessels
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.40

units.locator: Article 23.40. Authorities of the State Inspectorate for Small Vessels
units.text: 1) the Chief State Inspector for Small Vessels and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.40

units.locator: Article 23.40. Authorities of the State Inspectorate for Small Vessels
units.text: 2) chief state inspectors for small vessels of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.40

units.locator: Article 23.40. Authorities of the State Inspectorate for Small Vessels
units.text: 3) state inspectors for small vessels.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.40

units.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
units.text: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
units.label: Art. 23.42

units.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
units.label: Art. 23.42

units.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
units.text: 1. Authorities authorised in the field of aviation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.2, 8.2.1, 8.2.2 and 8.2.3 (with respect to violation of environmental requirements in air transport), Article 8.3 (with respect to violation of the rules for handling pesticides and agrochemicals in air transport), Articles 8.22 and 8.23, Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of civil aviation facilities and passenger transport services in civil aviation), parts 1 and 3 - 6 of Article 11.3, Article 11.3.1, parts 1 - 6, 8 and 9 of Article 11.5, Article 11.5.1, part 1 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1, part 1 of Article 11.15.2, Article 11.16, part 4 of Article 11.17 (with respect to violation of the rules for using radio communications equipment on board an aircraft), part 6 of Article 11.17, Articles 11.30 and 11.31, part 10 of Article 19.5, Article 19.7.5, part 1 of Article 19.7.9, and part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to state registration of civil aircraft) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.42

units.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.42

units.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of transport, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of transport, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of transport, their deputies, and other officials of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of transport who are authorised to exercise control and supervision in the sphere of transport (state transport inspectors) — concerning administrative offences committed in civil aviation and provided for by Articles 8.2, 8.2.1, 8.2.2 and 8.2.3 (with respect to violation of environmental requirements in air transport), Article 8.3 (with respect to violation of the rules for handling pesticides and agrochemicals in air transport), Articles 8.22 and 8.23, Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of civil aviation facilities and passenger transport services in civil aviation), parts 1 and 3 - 6 of Article 11.3, Article 11.3.1, parts 1 - 6, 8 and 9 of Article 11.5, Article 11.5.1, part 1 of Article 11.14, Article 11.15, part 1 of Article 11.15.1, part 1 of Article 11.15.2, Article 11.16, parts 4 and 6 of Article 11.17, Articles 11.30 and 11.31, part 10 of Article 19.5, Article 19.7.5, part 1 of Article 19.7.9, and part 1 of Article 19.22 (with respect to state registration of civil aircraft) of this Code;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.42

units.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
units.text: 2) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of defence, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of defence, their deputies, heads of inspection services of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of defence, their deputies, and aviation flight safety inspectors — concerning administrative offences committed in state aviation and provided for by parts 1, 3, 5 and 6 of Article 11.3, Article 11.3.1, parts 1 - 6, 8 and 9 of Article 11.5, part 1 of Article 11.14, and Articles 11.16 and 11.30 of this Code;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.42

units.locator: Article 23.42. Authorities Authorised in the Field of Aviation
units.text: 3) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the sphere of the defence industry complex, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority authorised in the sphere of the defence industry complex and their deputies — concerning administrative offences committed in experimental aviation and provided for by parts 1, 3, 5 and 6 of Article 11.3, Article 11.3.1, parts 1 - 6, 8 and 9 of Article 11.5, part 1 of Article 11.14, and Articles 11.16 and 11.30 of this Code.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.42

units.locator: Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use
units.text: Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use
units.label: Art. 23.43

units.locator: Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use
units.label: Art. 23.43

units.locator: Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the field of airspace use shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 11.4, part 1 of Article 11.15.1, part 1 of Article 11.15.2, parts 1 and 2 of Article 18.1 (with respect to violation of the airspace of the Russian Federation), and Article 19.7.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.43

units.locator: Article 23.43. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Airspace Use
units.text: 2. The head of the authorised federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the field of airspace use, his or her deputies, heads of territorial authorities of the authorised federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the field of airspace use and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.43

units.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications
units.text: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications
units.label: Art. 23.44

units.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications
units.label: Art. 23.44

units.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of communications facilities and services), Articles 13.2, 13.3, 13.4 and 13.6 - 13.9, part 1 of Article 13.18, Articles 13.27.1, 13.29 and 13.29.4, part 1 of Article 13.31, Articles 13.32 and 13.33.1, part 1 of Article 13.35, part 1 of Article 13.36, part 1 of Article 13.37, parts 1, 2 and 3 of Article 13.40, Article 13.40.1, part 2 of Article 13.43.1, part 1 of Article 13.50, Articles 13.55 and 13.56, parts 15 - 17 of Article 14.3, parts 2, 3 and 5 of Article 14.3.1, parts 1 - 3 of Article 15.27 (within their powers), part 1 of Article 15.48 (within their powers), parts 1, 1.1, 2 - 4, 6 and 7 of Article 19.7.10, and Articles 19.7.10-1 and 19.7.10-2 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.44

units.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.44

units.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications
units.text: 1) the Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Supervision in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.44

units.locator: Article 23.44. Authorities Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Communications, Information Technologies and Mass Communications
units.text: 2) senior state inspectors of the Russian Federation for supervision in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.44

units.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.text: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.label: Art. 23.45

units.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.label: Art. 23.45

units.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.text: 1. Federal executive authorities exercising control over the protection of state secrets shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3, 4 and 7 of Article 13.12 and part 2 of Article 13.13 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.45

units.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.45

units.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.45

units.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.text: 2) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of defence, his or her deputies, the head of the central military command authority responsible in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation for coordinating the main areas of activity for protecting restricted-access information, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions for the protection of state secrets of large formations, formations and military units of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, their deputies, heads of structural divisions for the protection of state secrets of organisations forming part of the services and branches of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation and of troops not forming part of the services and branches of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.45

units.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.text: 3) repealed. — Federal Law of 30.06.2003 No. 86-FZ;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.45

units.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.text: 4) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of foreign intelligence and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.45

units.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.text: 5) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of countering technical intelligence and technical protection of information, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.45

units.locator: Article 23.45. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising Control over the Protection of State Secrets
units.text: 6) heads of units of federal executive authorities authorised in the fields of ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, defence of the Russian Federation, foreign intelligence, countering technical intelligence and technical protection of information that license types of activity involving the use and protection of information constituting a state secret, and their deputies.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.45

units.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.text: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.label: Art. 23.46

units.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.label: Art. 23.46

units.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.text: 1. Federal executive authorities exercising state control in the field of information circulation and protection shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 13.5, Article 13.6, part 3 of Article 13.11.3 (within their powers), parts 1, 2 and 6 of Article 13.12, part 1 of Article 13.13, and Articles 13.17, 13.22, 20.23 and 20.24 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.46

units.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.46

units.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.text: 1) repealed. — Federal Law of 30.06.2003 No. 86-FZ;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.46

units.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.text: 1.1) the head of the federal executive authority in the field of state protection, his or her deputies, heads of units of that federal executive authority and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 13.5 of this Code;
units.label: Point 1.1 Part 2 Art. 23.46

units.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.text: 2) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of countering technical intelligence and technical protection of information, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority — concerning administrative offences provided for by part 3 of Article 13.11.3 (within their powers), parts 1, 2 and 6 of Article 13.12, and part 1 of Article 13.13 of this Code;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.46

units.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.text: 3) the head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of security of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority — concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 13.5, Article 13.6, part 3 of Article 13.11.3 (within their powers), parts 1, 2 and 6 of Article 13.12, part 1 of Article 13.13, and Articles 13.17, 20.23 and 20.24 of this Code;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.46

units.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.text: 4) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of communications, information technologies and mass communications, his or her deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority and their deputies — concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 13.17 and 13.22 of this Code;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.46

units.locator: Article 23.46. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control in the Field of Information Circulation and Protection
units.text: 5) repealed. — Federal Law of 28.12.2009 No. 380-FZ.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.46

units.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
units.text: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
units.label: Art. 23.48

units.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
units.label: Art. 23.48

units.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
units.text: 1. The federal antimonopoly authority and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 7.30.5 and 9.15, part 6, part 12 (except collective (building-wide), individual and shared (for communal apartments) meters for energy resources used in apartment buildings and residential houses) and part 13 (except collective (building-wide), individual and shared (for communal apartments) electricity meters in apartment buildings and residential houses) of Article 9.16, Article 9.21, parts 1 - 14 and 18 of Article 14.3, parts 4 and 5 of Article 14.3.1, part 1 of Article 14.9, Article 14.9.1, parts 6 and 10 of Article 14.24, Article 14.31, part 1 of Article 14.31.2, Articles 14.32 and 14.33, parts 1 and 3 - 5 of Article 14.38, Articles 14.40 - 14.42, parts 2 and 4 - 12 of Article 14.69, Article 19.4.3, parts 2.1 - 2.8 of Article 19.5, Article 19.8 (within their powers), part 1 of Article 19.8.1 (with respect to administrative offences committed by officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation in the field of state regulation of prices (tariffs) or officials of local self-government authorities regulating prices (tariffs), and Article 19.31 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.48

units.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.48

units.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
units.text: 1) the head of the federal antimonopoly authority and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.48

units.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal antimonopoly authority and their deputies, except cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 14 and 18 of Article 14.3, part 1 of Article 14.9, Article 14.31, part 1 of Article 14.31.2, and Articles 14.32 and 14.33 of this Code;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.48

units.locator: Article 23.48. Federal Antimonopoly Authority and Its Territorial Authorities
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal antimonopoly authority and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.48

units.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection
units.text: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection
units.label: Art. 23.49

units.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection
units.label: Art. 23.49

units.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of consumer rights protection shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of Article 9.16, Article 10.8 (with respect to violation of the rules for storage and sale of livestock products), Article 14.2, parts 1 and 6 - 8 of Article 14.3.1, Article 14.4, part 1 of Article 14.5, Articles 14.6 - 14.8 and 14.15, parts 2.1 - 3 of Article 14.16, Article 14.17.3, parts 2 - 4 and 6 - 8 of Article 14.34, parts 1, 2 and 4 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, parts 6 - 10 of Article 14.51, Article 14.53, parts 1 and 3 of Article 14.69, Article 14.70, and part 1 of Article 15.46 (with respect to the sale of jewellery and other articles of precious metals and/or precious stones under a retail sale contract) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.49

units.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.49

units.locator: Article 23.49. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Consumer Rights Protection
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of consumer rights protection and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.49
